description: Current list price of one SKU (id like vps/ovhcloud/vps-2027-model2 or llm/official/anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5) with all secondary prices, USD/EUR equivalents, spec, source URL, verified_at, a stale flag that is true when the source's latest fetch failed (the price shown is then the last verified one), other listings of the same model, and headline_commit where the provider headlines a commitment price (a labelled secondary price; the primary price has no commitment). Returns an error object for an unknown id.
